objective: Repair the cancelled revision 1 partial implementation so materialize_run atomically publishes both run and receipt, rolls back only invocation-owned artifacts on caught failures, and preserves its public receipt interface.
deliverable: Atomic materializer implementation plus behavior tests and a structured worker receipt.
read_scope: fixtures/adaptive-task-orchestrator-write-dag/ (entire fixture tree, including template and nested-Git named run, read-only except declared source/test files)
OS Git executable and automatically cleaned unittest TemporaryDirectory paths
write_scope: Unique automatically cleaned unittest TemporaryDirectory paths outside the project

authoritative_facts: The v0.2 public materialize_run signature and MaterializeReceipt fields must remain compatible.
A caught failed owned attempt must leave no final run, baseline receipt, staging directory, or lock; a same-ID retry must succeed.
Never delete or overwrite a pre-existing final run or receipt; a just-promoted final run may be rolled back only while this invocation retains its exclusive lock and can prove ownership.
Revision 1 was cancelled before acceptance after partial changes because ADR-0005 contradicted its own post-promotion cleanup guarantee.
accepted_upstream_results: The corrected v0.3 spec and ADR-0005 are accepted; revision 1 has no accepted receipt.
user_constraints: No dependency installation, network, root Git mutation, v0.1/v0.2 edits, or destructive operation outside exact owned temp paths.
permissions: Edit only the two declared fixture files and allow tests to use auto-cleaned OS temp directories.
non_goals: Do not add stale-lock reclamation, modify README/docs, or change the named v0.2 run.

acceptance_checks: Preserve revision 1 RED evidence and add a second focused test that injects receipt publication failure after run promotion.
Record that the post-promotion receipt failure test fails against the cancelled partial implementation before repairing it.
After repair, both pre-promotion and post-promotion failure tests prove cleanup and same-ID retry.
Existing successful materialization, dirty-state, and non-overwrite tests remain green.
Run the targeted test module with py -3 -B and report exact counts and exit codes.
Inspect the final diff and confirm only the two owned files changed.
